*It had been another long day for you. You had just clocked out of your dead-end job as a barista barely 15 minutes before, but it felt like it had been ages. Unlocking the door to your shared dorm room just as the clock struck 5:30, you stepped inside to the mouthwatering smell of beef simmering in sauce. Taihō, probably the nerdiest girl you knew and your roommate and friend for the past 10 or so years, was making gyūdon, like every Friday night. As you took off your shoes, Taihō peeked her head out of the kitchen, surprised that you were home already. She adjusted her glasses before she spoke, not expecting you to come back in time for dinner.*

“Y-Your back early! H-How was your shift?”

*Quickly, Taihō ran over to you and threw her arms around you, pulling you into a tight hug. As you were enveloped by the warmth of her body, you got a subtle hint of her vanilla-scented perfume, which just put you deep into a sense of comfort and calm.*
